title.narrative: China Economic Transformation and Institutional Capacity Building

description.narrative: Project Development Objectives are to (i) inform China's policy making and (ii) strengthen capacity to implement priority reform areas articulated in China's Five-Year Plans and other development programs.

The development objectives of the Economic Transformation and Institutional Capacity Building Project for China are to: (i) inform China's policy making; and (ii) strengthen capacity to implement priority reform areas articulated in China's five-year plans and other development programs. The project comprises of two components. The first component, analytical outputs include sectoral research, technical studies, and topical reports. The following six thematic areas will be priorities anticipated in China's development: (1) fiscal and financial reform; (2) economic restructuring; (3) rural and urban integration; (4) green economy; (5) reform of the national innovation system; and (6) public service delivery (education, healthcare, and social welfare). The second component, implementation support, project management, and capacity building will support activities including: (i) various types of training and knowledge sharing (local and abroad); (ii) overseas study in technical areas and scholarships for professional development of senior officials in foreign universities and institutes; (iii) secondment programs to international organizations; (iv) institution building (for example, workshops, seminars, and courses); (v) information platforms and information systems management; and (vi) implementation support at the central and also subproject levels (for example, financial management, budget oversight and disbursement, record keeping, procurement, monitoring and evaluation).

title.narrative: Number of beneficiaries participating in capacity building activities

comment.narrative: <p>SIA staff and researchers participated in the activities of overseas study in technical areas and trainings on technical topics and project implementation management.   The activities supported and enabled policy makers to draw on international knowledge and best practices in design and implementation of policies, as well as  grew government staff's knowledge base.</p>

<p>42 analytical outputs were published and the new knowledge generated reached out and shared broadly with intended policy makers and targeted audience, thus enhancing awareness, understanding and implementation capability of the policy makers. Moreover, the project provided information, models and data input for 6 government public service information platforms to upgrade and improve public service in key reform agenda.</p>

<p><strong>The PDO indicator 1 was fully achieved and exceeded</strong>.    The objective of the project was to inform policy making for development program.  Study inputs and recommendations derived from 60 subprojects were adopted in 44 policies issued by the state council, ministries and provincial governments.  The project made useful contributions to development outcomes. The ICR provides detailed information and evidence of the achievements.</p>

<p>51 analytical outputs delivered and disseminated in form of dissemination workshop and publication, reaching out to broader policy makers and local researchers to learn new knowledge and ideas for policy development and policy implementation.</p>

<ul>
 <li>Provision of knowledge and dataset for government public service information platforms to improve effectiveness of the platforms in the areas of green development and rural revitalization. 
 <ul>
  <li>"<strong>Green manufacturing pulic service platform</strong>" (ministry of industry and information technology)</li>
  <li>"<strong>Information management platform for green and low-carbon coordinated development of urban transportation in the region of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei" (</strong>ministry of ecology and environment)</li>
  <li><strong>“Poverty Prevention Monitoring and Early Warning Information platform in Guangdong province</strong>” (Guangdong provincial rural revitalization Bureau)</li>
  <li><strong>"China responsible forest product trade and investment information service platform" (</strong>National Forestry and Grassland Administration)</li>
 </ul>
 </li>
</ul>
